observed_exactly_recovered: User clarified that the LISTEN prototype ring/waveform—not the LIVE racer skin—was the intended donor for a READFIELD-like lens.
User wants left/right scrubbing in addition to wheel/vertical scale movement.
User wants the ability to pin and annotate positions.
User identifies a broader transfer: map the same interaction to reading and other data streams.
User notes richer contemporary music-source identification such as key/tempo-related metadata as a useful direction.
reconstructed: The durable mechanism is one canonical source address viewed through changing apertures/projections.
Horizontal motion and vertical motion become orthogonal operations: ADDRESS vs APERTURE.
Annotations should attach to source identity + address as authored evidence, not contaminate derived analysis.
Host vocabularies stay unequal: audio may use BEAT/PHRASE/SECTION/TRACK; text or sensors must define their own scales.
implemented: generic field-addressed-stream/v0.1 module with address↔fraction, relative scrub, aperture-relative step and source-addressed pins
LISTEN horizontal trackpad/shift-wheel address scrub; vertical wheel/up-down aperture traversal
left/right fine address movement; shift-left/right explicit beat step
pin exports beside AUDIO MAP under annotations, never mutating map evidence
provider-independent local chroma key + major/minor estimate with confidence
best-effort preservation of provider BPM/key/time signature only when fields actually exist
LISTEN UI recast as SOURCE → ADDRESS → APERTURE → FIELD

portable_law.projection: ring, line, RSVP, path, waveform, plot, etc.; does not own source identity
portable_law.annotation: authored evidence addressed to source+position; separate from machine-derived features
portable_law.return: source identity + address + aperture + annotations remain recoverable

constraints: Do not describe audio labels as universal stream semantics.
Do not treat approximate key/mode as ground truth.
Do not depend on undocumented provider metadata fields.
Do not build a second host adapter until direct LISTEN 0.3 interaction is proved.
Do not turn FIELD PULSE into a hub to carry every new identity feature.
next_truth: Desktop/phone: horizontal address movement must feel clearly different from vertical aperture change.
Pins must persist by source identity, seek correctly and survive export/reload.
Key/mode estimates must be judged on several materially different songs as approximate evidence.
Existing LISTEN→LIVE/READFIELD/TWO DIAL workflows must remain intact.
successor_note: If this survives, READFIELD should adapt the same address/aperture/pin law using text-native scales. It should not copy LISTEN's waveform, beat vocabulary or LIVE's racer HUD.
